```{r}
#| label: setup
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)
```

```{r}
#| label: curation-helpers

platform_patterns <- c(
  "Visium HD"              = "Visium[^;]{0,15}\\bHD",
  "Visium"                 = "Visium",
  "GeoMx"                  = "GeoMx",
  "MERFISH"                = "MERFISH|MERSCOPE",
  "CosMx"                  = "CosMx",
  "Xenium"                 = "Xenium",
  "Molecular Cartography"  = "Molecular Cartography",
  "In situ sequencing"     = "in situ sequencing|\\bISS\\b",
  "PhenoCycler"            = "PhenoCycler|CODEX",
  "Stereo-seq"             = "Stereo-?seq",
  "Slide-seq"              = "Slide-?seq",
  "Imaging mass cytometry" = "imaging mass cytometry|\\bIMC\\b",
  "Laser capture"          = "laser[- ]capture|\\bLCM\\b")

# Elicit writes "Not applicable/reported/mentioned ..." when a study has no
# qualifying spatial assay or when the platform could not be established.
no_platform <- "^(not applicable|not reported|not mentioned)"

# A study that ran only Visium HD should not also carry the plain Visium tag, so
# plain Visium is claimed only by a semicolon-separated segment with no HD in it.
has_plain_visium <- function(x) {
  seg <- str_split_1(x, ";")
  any(str_detect(seg, regex("Visium", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
        !str_detect(seg, regex("\\bHD", ignore_case = TRUE)))}

tag_platforms <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || str_detect(x, regex(no_platform, ignore_case = TRUE))) return(character(0))
  keep <- map_lgl(platform_patterns, \(p) str_detect(x, regex(p, ignore_case = TRUE)))
  tags <- names(platform_patterns)[keep]
  if ("Visium HD" %in% tags && !has_plain_visium(x)) setdiff(tags, "Visium") else tags}

split_plus <- function(x) str_split_1(x, fixed(" + ")) |> str_trim()

tidy_modality <- function(x) {
  split_plus(x) |>
    str_replace("^spatial Omics$", "Spatial omics") |>
    setdiff("Not established in available text")}

tidy_context <- function(x) {
  split_plus(x) |>
    str_replace("^None of requested categories stated$", "Not stated")}

split_bullets <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(character(0))
  str_split_1(x, "\n\\s*-\\s+") |>
    str_remove("^-\\s+") |>
    str_trim() |>
    discard(\(s) s == "")}

# Elicit reports counts as free text; take the explicit "(N ... total)" when the
# study gives one, otherwise the leading integer. Rows flagged Ambiguous get no
# number, since their leading integer is not the donor total.
count_donors <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || str_starts(x, "Ambiguous")) return(NA_integer_)
  total <- str_match(x, "\\((\\d+)\\s+\\w+\\s+total\\)")[, 2]
  as.integer(coalesce(total, str_extract(x, "^\\d+")))}
```

```{r}
#| label: accession-helpers

accession_rules <- tribble(
  ~pattern,            ~base,
  "GSE\\d{4,}",        "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=",
  "PRJ[EDN][A-Z]\\d+", "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/",
  "SR[PRXS]\\d{5,}",   "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sra/?term=",
  "E-MTAB-\\d+",       "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/arrayexpress/studies/",
  "E-GEAD-\\d+",       "https://ddbj.nig.ac.jp/search/entry/gea/",
  "S-BSST\\d+",        "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/studies/",
  "EGAS\\d{6,}",       "https://ega-archive.org/studies/",
  "EGAD\\d{6,}",       "https://ega-archive.org/datasets/",
  "EGAC\\d{6,}",       "https://ega-archive.org/dacs/",
  "HRA\\d{6}",         "https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/gsa-human/browse/",
  "OMIX\\d{6}",        "https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/omix/release/",
  "PXD\\d{6}",         "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/pride/archive/projects/",
  "DR[RAX]\\d{5,}",    "https://ddbj.nig.ac.jp/search/entry/sra-run/")

match_rule <- function(txt, pattern, base) {
  ids <- str_extract_all(txt, regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))[[1]] |> toupper() |> unique()
  tibble(label = ids, url = paste0(base, ids))}

# Accessions are matched on the URL-stripped text so an ID quoted inside its own
# repository link is not counted twice.
find_accessions <- function(txt) {
  bare <- str_remove_all(txt, "https?://\\S+")
  map2(accession_rules$pattern, accession_rules$base, \(p, b) match_rule(bare, p, b)) |>
    list_rbind()}

find_dois <- function(txt) {
  dois <- str_remove_all(txt, "https?://\\S+") |>
    str_extract_all("10\\.\\d{4,}/[^\\s,;)]+") |>
    pluck(1) |>
    str_remove("[.;,]$") |>
    unique()
  tibble(label = dois, url = paste0("https://doi.org/", dois))}

find_urls <- function(txt, known) {
  urls <- str_extract_all(txt, "https?://[^\\s,;)]+")[[1]] |> str_remove("[.;,]$") |> unique()
  urls <- discard(urls, \(u) any(str_detect(u, fixed(known, ignore_case = TRUE))))
  tibble(label = str_remove(urls, "^https?://(www\\.)?") |> str_extract("^[^/]+"), url = urls)}

data_links <- function(txt) {
  if (is.na(txt) || !str_starts(txt, "Yes")) return(tibble(label = character(), url = character()))
  acc <- find_accessions(txt)
  out <- bind_rows(acc, find_dois(txt), find_urls(txt, acc$label))
  distinct(out, url, .keep_all = TRUE)}
```

```{r}
#| label: catalog
#| output: asis

raw <- read_csv("data/liver-atlas/catalog.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  distinct(DOI, .keep_all = TRUE)

stopifnot(nrow(raw) > 0)

records <- raw |>
  transmute(
    title        = Title,
    authors      = Authors,
    first_author = map_chr(Authors, \(a) str_split_1(a, ",\\s*")[1]),
    url          = URL,
    doi          = DOI,
    year         = as.integer(Year),
    journal      = `Journal Or Server`,
    quartile     = str_replace(`Journal Quartile`, "^Not reported.*", "n/r"),
    evidence     = if_else(`Evidence Status` == "Full-text confirmed", "confirmed", "provisional"),
    modality     = map(Modality, tidy_modality),
    context      = map(`Biological Context`, tidy_context),
    platforms    = map(`Spatial Omics Platform`, tag_platforms),
    spatial_raw  = `Spatial Omics Platform`,
    donors_text  = `Human Liver Individuals Profiled`,
    donors_n     = map_int(`Human Liver Individuals Profiled`, count_donors),
    data_status  = case_when(str_starts(`Public Data Availability`, "Yes") ~ "Yes",
                             str_starts(`Public Data Availability`, "No public") ~ "No",
                             .default = "Unknown"),
    data_raw     = `Public Data Availability`,
    links        = map(`Public Data Availability`, data_links),
    focus        = `Study Focus`,
    results      = map(`Main Results`, split_bullets),
    summary      = Summary)

# "<\/" keeps a stray "</script>" inside an abstract from closing the JSON block.
payload <- toJSON(records, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null") |>
  str_replace_all(fixed("</"), "<\\/")

cat("\n\n")
cat(as.character(tags$script(type = "application/json", id = "liver-catalog", HTML(payload))))
cat("\n\n")
```

```{=html}
<div id="liver-atlas" class="liver-atlas column-screen-inset">

  <p class="la-lede">
    A curated catalog of original-research studies that profiled <strong>human liver</strong>
    material by single-cell RNA-seq, single-nucleus RNA-seq or spatial omics. Every record was
    screened against the same eligibility rules, and the disease context, cohort size, spatial
    platform and public-data deposition were extracted field by field so they can be filtered
    rather than read. Bulk RNA-seq, scATAC-seq and validation-only FISH or IHC do not qualify.
  </p>

  <div class="la-stats" id="la-stats"></div>

  <div class="la-hist-wrap">
    <div class="la-hist-head">
      <span class="la-section-label">Studies per year</span>
      <span class="la-hint">click a bar to filter</span>
    </div>
    <div class="la-hist" id="la-hist"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="la-toolbar">
    <div class="la-search">
      <input type="search" id="la-search" autocomplete="off"
             placeholder="Search title, authors, findings, journal, accession…"
             aria-label="Search the catalog">
    </div>
    <div class="la-toolbar-right">
      <label class="la-select">Sort
        <select id="la-sort">
          <option value="year-desc">Newest first</option>
          <option value="year-asc">Oldest first</option>
          <option value="donors-desc">Most donors</option>
          <option value="title-asc">Title A-Z</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <div class="la-viewtoggle" role="group" aria-label="View mode">
        <button type="button" data-view="cards" class="is-active">Cards</button>
        <button type="button" data-view="table">Table</button>
      </div>
      <button type="button" id="la-download" class="la-download">Download CSV</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="la-body">
    <div class="la-rail">
      <details open>
        <summary class="la-rail-summary">Filters <span id="la-active-count"></span></summary>
        <div id="la-facets"></div>
      </details>
    </div>

    <div class="la-results">
      <div class="la-count-bar">
        <span id="la-count"></span>
        <button type="button" id="la-clear" class="la-clear">Clear all filters</button>
      </div>
      <div id="la-output"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <p class="la-foot">
    Cohort sizes are the counts stated by the authors; where a study reports several
    sub-cohorts the sorting number is the first or explicitly total count, so read the
    full text on the card before quoting it. Records marked
    <span class="la-badge la-badge-prov">provisional</span> were screened on title and
    abstract only, and their fields are correspondingly incomplete.
  </p>

</div>
```

```{r}
#| label: dictionary
#| output: asis

dict_row <- function(field, definition, values) {
  tags$tr(tags$th(field, scope = "row"), tags$td(definition), tags$td(values))}

dict_rows <- read_csv("data/liver-atlas/dictionary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(Column != "Linked source") |>
  select(field = Column, definition = Definition, values = `Categories Or Format`) |>
  pmap(dict_row)

dict_head <- tags$tr(tags$th("Field"), tags$th("Definition"), tags$th("Values"))

dict_block <- tags$div(
  class = "liver-atlas column-screen-inset",
  tags$details(
    class = "la-dict",
    tags$summary("How each field was defined"),
    tags$table(class = "la-dict-table", tags$thead(dict_head), tags$tbody(dict_rows))))

cat("\n\n")
cat(as.character(dict_block))
cat("\n\n")
```
